Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files using AES-128 encryption with .Reyptson extension
Spreads by conducting spam email campaigns from victim's Thunderbird email client using stolen credentials and contact list
Distributes fake invoice emails with malicious factura.pdf.rar executable
Connects to remote Command & Control server to receive encryption password and payment server credentials
Launches fake PDF and lock screen ransom note
Uses TOR payment server for ransom payment
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Thunderbird email client installed
Attack Vector: Execution of malicious factura.pdf.rar file received via spam email from victim's Thunderbird contacts
Use of victim's Thunderbird email client to spread ransomware via spam
